record.field: SELECT DISTINCT d.rspos, d.potx1, d.charg, a.aufnr, a.auart,d.matnr, d.bdmng,d.enmng,d.rsnum, md.maktx,eba.matnr as sku, eba.txz01, eba.banfn, pt.priokx, a.ktext, fe.fetxt, viq.strmn, viq.strur, viq.ltrmn, viq.ltrur, a.werks,d.xloek,d.kzear, es.kzabn FROM aufk a left JOIN afko k ON a.mandt = k.mandt AND a.aufnr = k.aufnr left JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr left JOIN resb d ON a.mandt = d.mandt AND k.rsnum = d.rsnum left JOIN qmel qm ON a.mandt = qm.mandt AND a.aufnr = qm.aufnr inner JOIN viqmfe fe ON qm.mandt = fe.mandt AND qm.qmnum = fe.qmnum inner join viqmel viq on qm.qmnum = viq.qmnum and qm.mandt = viq.mandt inner JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' left join makt md on d.matnr = md.matnr and d.mandt = md.mandt and md.spras = 'E' left join ebkn eb on eb.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = eb.mandt left join eban eba on eba.banfn = eb.banfn and eba.mandt = eb.mandt left join ekkn ek on ek.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = ek.mandt left JOIN essr es ON es.ebeln = ek.ebeln AND es.ebelp = ek.ebelp

SELECT DISTINCT d.rspos, d.potx1, d.charg, a.aufnr, a.auart,il.tplnr,b.equnr, d.matnr, d.bdmng,d.enmng,d.rsnum, md.maktx,eba.matnr as sku, eba.txz01, eba.banfn, pt.priokx, a.ktext, fe.fetxt, viq.strmn, viq.strur, viq.ltrmn, viq.ltrur, a.werks,d.xloek,d.kzear, es.kzabn FROM aufk a left JOIN afko k ON a.mandt = k.mandt AND a.aufnr = k.aufnr left JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr left JOIN resb d ON a.mandt = d.mandt AND k.rsnum = d.rsnum left JOIN qmel qm ON a.mandt = qm.mandt AND a.aufnr = qm.aufnr inner JOIN viqmfe fe ON qm.mandt = fe.mandt AND qm.qmnum = fe.qmnum inner join viqmel viq on qm.qmnum = viq.qmnum and qm.mandt = viq.mandt inner JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' left join makt md on d.matnr = md.matnr and d.mandt = md.mandt and md.spras = 'E' left join ebkn eb on eb.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = eb.mandt left join eban eba on eba.banfn = eb.banfn and eba.mandt = eb.mandt left join ekkn ek on ek.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = ek.mandt left JOIN essr es ON es.ebeln = ek.ebeln AND es.ebelp = ek.ebelp inner join iloa il on il.iloan = b.iloan and il.iloan = b.iloan

SELECT DISTINCT d.rspos, d.potx1, d.charg, a.aufnr, a.auart,il.tplnr,b.equnr, d.matnr,mh.nplda, d.bdmng,d.enmng,d.rsnum, md.maktx,eba.matnr as sku, eba.txz01, eba.banfn, pt.priokx, a.ktext, a.werks,d.xloek,d.kzear, es.kzabn, CASE WHEN (d.rsnum IS NULL OR d.rsnum LIKE '% ') AND (eba.banfn IS NULL OR eba.banfn LIKE '% ') THEN 'Inspection' WHEN (d.rsnum IS NOT NULL AND d.rsnum NOT LIKE '% ') AND (eba.banfn IS NULL OR eba.banfn LIKE '% ') THEN 'pergantian sparepart' ELSE 'Lainnya' END AS order_category FROM aufk a left JOIN afko k ON a.mandt = k.mandt AND a.aufnr = k.aufnr inner JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr left JOIN resb d ON a.mandt = d.mandt AND k.rsnum = d.rsnum inner JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' left join makt md on d.matnr = md.matnr and d.mandt = md.mandt and md.spras = 'E' left join ebkn eb on eb.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = eb.mandt left join eban eba on eba.banfn = eb.banfn and eba.mandt = eb.mandt left join ekkn ek on ek.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = ek.mandt left JOIN essr es ON es.ebeln = ek.ebeln AND es.ebelp = ek.ebelp inner join iloa il on il.iloan = b.iloan and il.mandt = b.mandt inner join mhis mh on mh.warpl = b.warpl AND mh.abnum = b.abnum and mh.mandt = b.mandt WHERE a.auart IN ('ZLS4','ZLF4') and a.werks in('1321','1443')

SELECT a.warpl, a.wptxt, c.nplda, mhi.aufnr, if.tplnr, b.equnr,mhi.tsenq,b.iwerk FROM mpla a inner JOIN mpos b ON b.warpl = a.warpl AND b.mandt = a.mandt left JOIN mhis c ON c.warpl = a.warpl AND c.mandt = a.mandt left JOIN iloa il ON il.iloan = b.iloan AND il.mandt = b.mandt left JOIN iflotx if ON if.tplnr = il.tplnr AND if.mandt = il.mandt AND if.spras = 'E' inner join mhio mhi on a.warpl = mhi.warpl and a.mandt = mhi.mandt AND mhi.abnum = c.abnum left join aufk d on d.aufnr = mhi.aufnr and d.mandt = mhi.mandt where (b.iwerk in('1321','1443') or b.iwerk = '' or b.iwerk is null)

SELECT DISTINCT d.rspos, d.potx1, d.charg, a.aufnr, a.auart, b.equnr, d.matnr, d.bdmng,d.enmng,d.rsnum, md.maktx,eba.matnr as sku, eba.txz01, eba.banfn, pt.priokx, a.ktext, a.werks,d.xloek,d.kzear, es.kzabn FROM aufk a inner JOIN afko k ON a.mandt = k.mandt AND a.aufnr = k.aufnr inner JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr left JOIN resb d ON a.mandt = d.mandt AND k.rsnum = d.rsnum inner JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' left join makt md on d.matnr = md.matnr and d.mandt = md.mandt and md.spras = 'E' left join ebkn eb on eb.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = eb.mandt left join eban eba on eba.banfn = eb.banfn and eba.mandt = eb.mandt left join ekkn ek on ek.aufnr = a.aufnr and a.mandt = ek.mandt left JOIN essr es ON es.ebeln = ek.ebeln AND es.ebelp = ek.ebelp WHERE a.auart IN ('ZLS5','ZLF5') and a.werks in('1321','1443')
select a.grund, a.grdtx, a.werks from trugt a where a.werks in('1321','1443') and a.spras = 'EN'
